title: Pushforward mass under an equivalence
statement: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be finite types, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\alpha$, let $e:\alpha\to\beta$ be a bijection, and let $b\in\beta$. The mass at $b$ of the probability mass function obtained by transporting $p$ along $e$ equals $p(e^{-1}(b))$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\alpha$
